en.text:
Starts linearly increasing Detonation and Burn (DoT) damage 0.2 seconds after the grenade projectile is fired.

Reaches maximum strength after 1.1 seconds at a 35% damage increase.

The damage increase is finalized at the point of detonation and any lingering effects left will not increase it further.

enhanced (
#e Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.
